GOOGLE_CHAT_SUBSCRIPTION_NAME.description: Optional Pub/Sub subscription path for pull-mode inbound events.

GOOGLE_CHAT_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated user emails allowed to interact with the bot.

GOOGLE_CHAT_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default space for cron / notification delivery (e.g. spaces/AAAA...).

SIGNAL_ACCOUNT.description: Signal account phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +15551234567)

SIGNAL_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated phone numbers or UUIDs allowed to DM the bot

SIGNAL_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any Signal user to talk to the bot (dev only)

SIGNAL_GROUP_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated group IDs allowed to talk to the bot (* for all groups)

SIGNAL_REQUIRE_MENTION.description: Only answer group messages that mention the bot (true/false, default: false)

SIGNAL_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default chat (phone number or group:<id>) for cron / notification delivery

SIGNAL_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Display name for the Signal home channel

BLUEBUBBLES_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default iMessage address / chat GUID for cron / notification delivery

BLUEBUBBLES_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Display name for the home channel

BLUEBUBBLES_SEND_READ_RECEIPTS.description: Auto-mark inbound messages read (default true; needs the Private API helper)

BLUEBUBBLES_REQUIRE_MENTION.description: Require a wake word in group chats (default false)

BLUEBUBBLES_MENTION_PATTERNS.description: Group wake-word regexes (JSON list or comma/newline-separated); default Hermes wake words

IRC_PORT.description: IRC server port (default: 6697 with TLS, 6667 without)

IRC_USE_TLS.description: Use TLS for the IRC connection (1/true/yes to enable, default: true on port 6697)

IRC_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated IRC nicks allowed to talk to the bot

IRC_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow anyone in the channel to talk to the bot (dev only)

IRC_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Channel for cron / notification delivery (defaults to IRC_CHANNEL)

FEISHU_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated Feishu user IDs allowed to talk to the bot

FEISHU_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any Feishu user to trigger the bot (dev only)

FEISHU_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default chat ID for cron / notification delivery

FEISHU_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Display name for the Feishu home channel

DISCORD_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any Discord user to trigger the bot (dev only)

DISCORD_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default channel ID for cron / notification delivery

DISCORD_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Display name for the Discord home channel

NTFY_TOPIC.description: Topic name to subscribe to (e.g. hermes-in)

NTFY_TOKEN.description: Bearer token or 'user:pass' for Basic auth (optional)

NTFY_PUBLISH_TOPIC.description: Topic to publish replies to (defaults to NTFY_TOPIC)

NTFY_MARKDOWN.description: Send replies with X-Markdown: true header (true/false, default: false)

NTFY_ALLOW_ALL_USERS.description: Allow any topic to talk to the bot (dev only — disables allowlist)

NTFY_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default topic for cron / notification delivery

NTFY_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Human label for the home channel (defaults to the topic name)

RAFT_PROFILE.description: Raft agent profile slug — auto-enables the adapter when set

DINGTALK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Static robot webhook URL for cross-platform / cron delivery

DINGTALK_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated staff/sender IDs allowed to talk to the bot (* = any)

DINGTALK_HOME_CHANNEL.description: Default conversation ID for cron / notification delivery

DINGTALK_HOME_CHANNEL_NAME.description: Display name for the DingTalk home channel
